_comment: THE MOTOR. P1.4's own worked example: in an infinite dump materials are worthless and function is precious, and there is no infinite supply of working motors.
TEACHES NOTHING (#390). Teardown yields FUNCTION now, not knowledge; the market is the only source of tier knowledge.

ONE COMPONENT, NOT TWO. This yielded a Pump before the Motor became its signature, and keeping both would have doubled its component yield AND left the Broken Hydroponics Bay's own signature identifying nothing. A washer holds a pump too; the Bay is where you go for one.
